'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Thomas DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Michael Thomas]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' mmThomas2
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
